integrity.basis: Exact affine-derivative elimination, polar-curve restriction, transverse Hessian and formal Morse lemma; standalone reproducibility checker included.

scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a completed local hypersurface ring, intrinsic Tjurina algebra and singular support; no semistable model, resolution or Fano scheme of lines is computed.
The computed singularity conflicts with the brief A_2 type designation in Debarre–Laface–Roulleau's Section 4.5.2; independent specialist reconciliation is outstanding.
Historic modular classification literature is not exhaustively searched.
title: The wild \(A_{10}\) local equation of the Klein cubic in characteristic eleven
